title: Optimal average-case complexity of Shellsort
formal: What is the minimum achievable asymptotic expected running time of Shellsort on a uniformly random permutation of n distinct keys, when its gap sequence is deterministic and chosen independently of that permutation?
context:
The sequence may depend on n and must end with gap 1; randomized or input-adaptive gap selection changes the question.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Seeks the final complexity of a basic sorting method whose performance depends strongly on its gap schedule.
